title: Palace gardens, Ginza car-free, sumo in Shinjuku
summary: The Imperial Palace East Gardens first thing, Ginza car-free from noon and the stores while it is dry, the Shinjuku Sumo Club show at 17:30, dinner in Shinjuku, then a late massage back in Ginza.

rows.detail: About 15 minutes' walk. Opens 09:00, free. Old castle keep foundations and the Ninomaru garden. Take your time.
On the walk from the gardens to Tokyo Station, instead of a sit-down breakfast.
Ten minutes east from Ōtemon. The red brick front from Gyōkō-dōri, the tree-lined avenue straight out from the palace.
Free 6F terrace right opposite, looking down on the station and the trains. About 20 minutes.
About 20 minutes south from Tokyo Station, down Sotobori-dōri or Chūō-dōri.
Ginza's oldest tonkatsu house, since 1927, in the basement at Ginza 7-8-1. Kurobuta (black pork) loin is the order. Daily 11:30 to 20:00, no bookings, queues up to 30 minutes at peak. Cards accepted.
Ginza 3-3-5, a few minutes north. Six floors: clothes, homewares, stationery and food. Passports for tax-free.

Chūō-dōri is pedestrian only until 17:00. Split up or stay together: UNIQLO TOKYO and Daiso (6F) in Marronnier Gate Ginza 2 next to MUJI, then down Chūō-dōri for Itoya stationery, Matsuya, Mitsukoshi at the 4-chōme crossing and Ginza Six. Passports for tax-free.

rows.what: Back to the hotel, rest and change
rows.detail: About 10 minutes' walk south from the 4-chōme crossing. Drop the shopping, put your feet up.

rows.what: Leave the hotel for the sumo: taxi in the rain
rows.detail: Taxi from the hotel door, about 25 minutes, about ¥3,500 to ¥4,000. Show: 新宿区大久保2-5-22 SEKISAKU ビル 2階までお願いします。 Leave by 16:45 at the latest. Train if traffic looks bad: How-to 32.

Main venue. About 75 to 90 minutes. Live bouts, English MC, Q&A, a chance to challenge a wrestler (lottery), photos, one drink. SEKISAKU Bldg 2F, 2-5-22 Ōkubo (新宿区大久保2-5-22). Booked on Klook for 2, about AU$74 each. Free cancellation closed (under 24 hours). Doors open 17:00. No entry more than 20 minutes after the start (17:50). Getting there and back: How-to 32.
Higashi-Shinjuku is close, but simplest: walk back to Shinjuku-sanchōme, Marunouchi line toward 銀座・池袋 to Ginza, about 17 minutes.

rows.what: Dinner: mapo tofu ramen or tantanmen at Ginza Rōsokuya
rows.detail: The mapo tofu ramen (spicy mince and tofu) is the signature; the tantanmen is the other one. Ginza 1-chōme. Open to 21:30, English menu, ticket machine. Medium spice is mild, so go a level up. Alternative by the sumo: Mōko Tanmen Nakamoto Shinjuku, spicy miso ramen topped with mapo tofu, 15 minutes' walk from the club, open to 23:00.
Buasai Ginza (Thai, Ginza 8-chōme, 5 minutes from the hotel, to midnight), YURAGI (Ginza 7-chōme, to midnight) or Head Spa ZEN (Ginza 2-chōme, to 23:00). Book ahead in the afternoon.

footnote: Rain expected in the afternoon: car-free Ginza first, then into the stores when it comes, and back to the hotel before the sumo.
